In menus: swipe to browse, double-tap to select, hold for details. In the world: one-finger swipes move, two-finger swipes scan. Two-finger tap reads status, two taps read messages. TalkBack may take over gestures.

Safe movement practice. Swipe in each of the eight directions. The reader will name the direction and count your progress. Practice swipes send no game action and spend no turn. Double tap or press Back to exit at any time; starting practice again resets your progress, so you can rehearse from the beginning.

Backup and restore. Export copies your saves and settings into one backup file that you choose. Import only replaces your current data after the chosen file has been checked and you confirm the replacement separately on this screen. Do imports from startup, before a game session starts, so the running game cannot save over restored data.
Export a backup of saves and settings
Import a backup and restore saves and settings

Export, step one of two. Nothing has been exported yet. When you activate the Continue button that is now enabled, the Android file picker opens and the system takes over the screen; this app\'s speech stops while the picker is open. In the picker, choose the folder and file name for the backup. If you pick the name of an existing file there, that chosen file will be replaced. Finishing or cancelling the picker returns you to this screen, and the result is announced here. Exporting never changes your saves or settings.

Import, step one of two. Nothing has been restored yet. When you activate the Continue button that is now enabled, the Android file picker opens and the system takes over the screen; this app\'s speech stops while the picker is open. In the picker, choose the backup file. Returning here, the file is only read and checked against your free storage; your current saves and settings are not replaced until you hear the check result and activate the separate Confirm restore button on this screen.
Continue: open the file picker to save the backup
